Let's explain how it works, and let's use nice, easy to understand, round numbers:

Let's say that you own a company which operates in Country-X. In Country-X, the law is that you have to pay 50% of your income as taxes. The only exception is that any income you "invest" isn't considered income, and is therefore not taxed. So, if you make $2M, you must pay $1M in taxes... unless you donate $500K to the "Girl Scouts of Country-X," then you owe $750K in taxes. As you can see, this could be beneficial, since you don't have to pay as much in taxes.

Now, what would happen if you got that $500K back, under the table, so that the government couldn't tax it? Well, even better, right? You literally have the same amount of money, but saved yourself $250K in taxes, right?

Well, this is what Panama did. They set up "businesses" and "charities" which accepted "donations" from celebrities and politicians... and then they returned almost all of it back to the celebrities and politicians. This allowed these celebrities and politicians to avoid paying taxes on their incomes. There were never any legitimate offshore companies to own or donate to, and there were no actual investments... just laundering money away.

Now, I use the word "laundering" in a meaningful way, because there was a second way that Panama was used. Let's say that your country wanted to fund some brutal warlord in another country, but didn't want to be seen funding that warlord, as it would be bad for your president/prime minister to be seen supporting such a brutal murderer... Well, how would you imagine going about doing that?

Well, laundering the money would be the best way. And the best way to do that is to set up some phony, off-shore company, which will "return" the money, except not to you... but to that warlord. Nobody is tracking your money once it's "donated" to the "Cure Blind Monkey Cancer Foundation," and nobody is expecting such a "business" to donate to a brutal warlord. You give $1M to Panama as a "donation," and Panama gives it to the warlord, and nobody is the wiser.

It's come out that some politicians have been doing this very thing... which is highly illegal.

The rub is that, as a normal citizen, you couldn't do this, and you had to pay 100% of your taxes. Hell, your taxes went into the pockets of these politicians... Then, your politicians went out and dodged their own taxes. Also, laundering money for any reason is illegal, regardless of who you are.
